requirements.text: CMake creates the count_even executable without errors using standard cmake commands.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |

requirements.text: Handle invalid arguments with correct exit codes and error messages in stderr (exit code 1 if argument count != 2, exit code 2 if invalid number, outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right).
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |

requirements.text: Count even integers correctly in the inclusive interval [left, right], including zero, positive, and negative values.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |

requirements.text: On success, print only one integer count followed by a newline to stdout with exit code 0; on error, stdout must be empty and a clear message printed to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |
| Output format | 1 | Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors |

criteria.title: Build
criteria.verification_method: Run `cmake -S . -B build` and `cmake --build build`, verifying that build completes successfully and produces the executable.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values.
criteria.verification_method: Execute `count_even` on test intervals including positive, negative, zero, and single-element bounds, checking the returned count.

criteria.title: CLI validation
criteria.description: Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments.
criteria.verification_method: Run `count_even` with invalid argument counts (expecting exit code 1), non-integers, out-of-range values, and left > right (expecting exit code 2 and stderr message).

criteria.title: Output format
criteria.description: Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors.
criteria.verification_method: Verify stdout format on success contains only the single count integer followed by \n; verify stdout is empty and errors are routed to stderr on failure.
